input.title: EC2 CPU Spike
input.description: EC2 instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8 showing 95% CPU utilization for 15 minutes. CloudWatch alarm triggered. Application response times increased from 200ms to 2s. No recent deployments.

expected.probableCause: sudden traffic increase or infinite loop in application code
expected.nextAction: scale EC2 instance or investigate application code for infinite loops

output.probableCause: An EC2 instance is experiencing high CPU utilization resulting in severe degradation of application response times.
evidence: EC2 instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8 showing 95% CPU utilization
Application response times increased from 200ms to 2s
Canonical categorization for this pattern: incidentType=performance, typicalSeverity=high
output.nextAction: Investigate application logs and process metrics to identify the root cause of the high CPU utilization, and consider scaling the instance or optimizing application code.

input.title: S3 Bucket Public Access
input.description: AWS Config rule flagged S3 bucket 'company-backups-2024' as publicly accessible. Bucket contains customer PII data. No IAM policy changes in last 24 hours.

expected.probableCause: misconfigured S3 bucket policy or ACL allowing public read access
expected.nextAction: immediately block public access, audit bucket contents, enable S3 block public settings

output.probableCause: An S3 bucket containing customer PII has been misconfigured to allow public access.
evidence: AWS Config rule flagged S3 bucket 'company-backups-2024' as publicly accessible
output.nextAction: Enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket immediately and audit data access logs.

input.title: RDS Connection Exhaustion
input.description: RDS PostgreSQL instance db-primary showing 98% connection usage. Application errors: 'too many connections'. Read replica lagging by 45 seconds.

expected.probableCause: connection pool misconfiguration or application leak
expected.nextAction: increase max_connections, investigate connection pooling, check for connection leaks

output.probableCause: The RDS PostgreSQL instance has reached near-maximum connection capacity resulting in application errors.
evidence: RDS PostgreSQL instance db-primary showing 98% connection usage
output.nextAction: Review connection pool configurations in the application and consider increasing max_connections or identifying connection leaks.

input.title: Lambda Throttling
input.description: Lambda function process-orders showing 429 errors. Duration increased from 1s to 8s. Concurrent executions at limit of 1000.

expected.probableCause: sudden increase in order processing volume exceeding concurrency limits
expected.nextAction: increase reserved concurrency, investigate batch size optimization, consider SQS buffering

output.probableCause: The Lambda function is hitting its concurrency limit of 1000, causing throttling and 429 errors.
evidence: KB entry 1 - Lambda Function Throttling with typicalSeverity medium
output.nextAction: Review function duration to free up concurrency faster or request an increase to the Lambda concurrency limit for the process-orders function.

input.title: API Gateway Latency Spike
input.description: API Gateway showing 504 errors and latency p95 increased from 300ms to 12s. Integration Lambda timing out after 10s.

expected.probableCause: backend database slow query or external API delay
expected.nextAction: increase Lambda timeout, optimize database queries, add caching layer

output.probableCause: The integration Lambda function is timing out after 10 seconds, causing API Gateway to return 504 errors and elevating latency.
evidence: Canonical categorization for this pattern: incidentType="timeout", typicalSeverity="high"
output.nextAction: Investigate integration Lambda logs to identify slow execution paths or database queries, and consider increasing timeout settings or optimizing code performance.

input.title: Mixed Signals - Deploy and Error
input.description: Deploy finished 10 minutes ago to ECS service web-frontend. Error rate increased from 0.1% to 5%. CPU normal at 40%. Memory usage increased from 60% to 85%.

expected.probableCause: new version has memory leak or inefficient code path
expected.nextAction: roll back deployment, investigate memory usage in new code, check logs for exceptions

output.probableCause: A recent deployment to the web-frontend ECS service introduced a bug or resource leak that increased the error rate to 5%.
evidence: Deploy finished 10 minutes ago to ECS service web-frontend.
KB entry 1 - Deployment-Related Issues matches symptoms of increased error rate post-deploy.
output.nextAction: Roll back the recent deployment or investigate the resource leak and error logs in the new code release.

input.title: Data Pipeline Failure
input.description: Glue job etl-nightly failed with OutOfMemoryError. Processing 2TB of S3 data. Job history shows gradually increasing duration over past 3 days.

expected.probableCause: data volume growth exceeding Glue worker memory capacity
expected.nextAction: increase Glue worker type, implement data partitioning, add snapshot isolation

output.probableCause: The Glue ETL job failed with an OutOfMemoryError due to data volume growth and insufficient worker resources while processing 2TB of S3 data.
evidence: Glue job etl-nightly failed with OutOfMemoryError
Job history shows gradually increasing duration over past 3 days
output.nextAction: Increase worker resources for the Glue job or implement data partitioning and optimize processing logic to handle the 2TB dataset.

input.title: Network Connectivity Issue
input.description: VPC flow shows REJECT traffic from app-subnet to db-subnet on port 5432. Security group unchanged. Applications losing DB connectivity intermittently.

expected.probableCause: network ACL or security group rule incorrectly blocking database traffic
expected.nextAction: check network ACLs, verify security group egress rules, test connectivity with nc command

output.probableCause: Network ACL rules or routing changes are blocking traffic from the application subnet to the database subnet on port 5432.
evidence: VPC flow shows REJECT traffic from app-subnet to db-subnet on port 5432
VPC REJECT logs and intermittent service connectivity match KB entry 1
output.nextAction: Inspect network ACLs and route tables associated with the app-subnet and db-subnet to identify and correct the rule causing REJECT traffic.

input.title: Certificate Expiry
input.description: Load balancer SSL certificate for api.example.com expired 2 hours ago. Clients getting SSL handshake failures. Certificate not rotated via ACM.

expected.probableCause: expired SSL/TLS certificate not renewed automatically
expected.nextAction: renew certificate in ACM, verify load balancer configuration, set up monitoring for expiry

output.probableCause: The SSL certificate for api.example.com expired and was not rotated via ACM, causing 100% of client TLS handshakes to fail.
evidence: Load balancer SSL certificate for api.example.com expired 2 hours ago
output.nextAction: Immediately provision, renew, or replace the expired SSL certificate on the load balancer and configure automated monitoring in ACM.

input.title: Cost Anomaly
input.description: AWS Cost Explorer shows Lambda costs increased 300% day-over-day. No traffic increase observed. Same number of invocations but longer duration.

expected.probableCause: infinite loop or inefficient processing in Lambda function increasing duration
expected.nextAction: identify high-cost Lambda functions, profile for performance issues, check for infinite loops

output.probableCause: AWS Lambda function costs increased due to longer execution durations despite flat invocation counts.
evidence: AWS Cost Explorer shows Lambda costs increased 300% day-over-day
Same number of invocations but longer duration
output.nextAction: Investigate CloudWatch logs for the affected Lambda functions to identify the cause of increased execution duration and optimize the function code.
